address: Rua Cristovão Pires Norte - Edificio Dunas Living, Almancil, 8135-117, Portugal
bio: Behind the name “austa”, a Latin term meaning “south wind”, lies, poetically, a veiled homage to the Algarve region and, above all, the intention to be a breath of fresh air in Almancil’s gastronomic landscape. In this restaurant with an alternative spirit (seen in its music, ambience and the terrace - which can even feel like a chill-out space, set in a rural-residential setting, you will find an appealing contemporary proposal. The exclusively à la carte menu encourages sharing and offers a more relaxed lunchtime dining experience.
